title: Just Juice Bar Range Raspberry & Grapefruit 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Raspberry and Grapefruit from the Just Juice Bar Range is a bright, citrus-infused berry blend that combines sweet Raspberry with the tangy sharpness of Grapefruit. The juicy, jammy Raspberry comes through first, lifted by a bold citrus twist that adds depth and brightness. The blend is finished with a cool burst of Ice for a clean, chilled exhale. Blended with nicotine salts for rapid absorption and a smoother throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices like pod kits and vape pens. With strengths in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg, it offers a satisfying vape for both light and heavy users. Made in the UK, Just Juice Bar Range Nic Salts are blended at a 60PG/40VG ratio to provide vivid flavour with subtle vapour. Designed to emulate the sweetness and chill of disposable-style vapes, this fruit-forward blend is ideal for vapers who enjoy bold, refreshing profiles in a refillable format. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
